title: Yoda’s Students Light the Way
front_description: Obi-Wan is surprised to discover that no star maps for Kamino's system exist in the official Jedi Archives. Convinced that Dexter lead is correct, he pays a call on Master Yoda and his young Jedi-in-training. Yoda presents Obi-Wan's questions to the class, and one sharp student concludes that the reason Kamino data doesn't show up is "because someone erased it from the archive memory."
back_description: The little actors who play Yoda's Jedi-in-training practice their lines.
